name: Framed caption layout
summary: A photo in a thin white frame on black, with a serif capital title and a small caption below.
how: Frame the photo with a 2px white line and a 3px black gap.
Set a title in white serif capitals centred under the frame.
Add one grey caption line under the title.

origin.note: Forum users copy the black frame of the demotivational poster and change its text.

adoptions.via: Poster generators and forums make the framed template a one-click form.
